result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon above the label, while all other navigation items ('Home', 'Search', 'Profile') display icons consistently.
issues.suggestion: Add an appropriate icon (such as a receipt or shopping bag icon) above the 'Orders' label in the bottom navigation bar to match the styling and alignment of the other tabs.
